notes.md: - **Prakasam Barrage:** built **1954-57** across the **Krishna** at **Vijayawada**, replacing the old anicut (1852-55); named after **Tanguturi Prakasam**, first Chief Minister of Andhra State.

new.s: What was the aim of the ten-year plan in M. Visvesvaraya's 'Planned Economy for India' (1934)?
o: To treble the national income in 15 years
new.x: Visvesvaraya's 1934 plan proposed a ten-year plan to double national income by shifting labour to industry.
new.angle: U0451 notes gap: Visvesvaraya plan -> double national income

new.s: With which session of the Indian National Congress is the setting up of the National Planning Committee (1938) by Subhas Chandra Bose associated?
new.x: Subhas Chandra Bose, as Congress President at Haripura (1938), initiated the National Planning Committee; Nehru chaired it.
new.angle: U0451 notes gap: NPC initiated at Haripura

new.s: Who prepared the Gandhian Plan of 1944?
new.x: The Gandhian Plan (1944), based on decentralised self-contained villages, was prepared by Shriman Narayan Agarwal.
new.angle: U0451 notes gap: Gandhian Plan -> Shriman Narayan Agarwal

new.s: Under whom was the Economic Programme Committee of 1947 set up?
new.x: The Economic Programme Committee of 1947 worked under Jawaharlal Nehru.
new.angle: U0451 notes gap: Economic Programme Committee 1947 -> Nehru

new.s: Which plan of 1934 aimed to double India's national income in ten years?
new.x: M. Visvesvaraya's 'Planned Economy for India' (1934) proposed doubling national income in ten years.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: double national income -> Visvesvaraya plan

new.s: Who was the Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission from June 1991 to May 1996?
new.x: Pranab Mukherjee was Deputy Chairman from June 1991 to May 1996.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: Deputy Chairman 1991-96 -> Pranab Mukherjee

new.s: Who among the following served as Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission from January 1985 to August 1987?
new.x: Manmohan Singh was Deputy Chairman from January 1985 to August 1987; P. Chidambaram never held the post.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: Deputy Chairman 1985-87 -> Manmohan Singh

new.s: Which body was set up after Independence to prepare a common plan for the country?
new.x: The Planning Commission (15 March 1950) was the body set up after Independence for a common plan.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: body for a common plan -> Planning Commission

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a chief objective of planning in India?
new.x: Growth, removal of poverty and self-reliance are listed objectives; 'to achieve social equality' is not a chief objective.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: social equality not a chief objective

new.s: How many 'Padi Sutralu' (guiding principles) does Andhra Pradesh's Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 have?
new.x: Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 is built on ten 'Padi Sutralu'.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: Swarna Andhra 2047 -> ten Padi Sutralu

new.s: What annual growth rate did Andhra Pradesh set in February 2026 to reach a GSDP of Rs 31 lakh crore by 2030?
new.x: On 10 February 2026 AP set targets of 15% annual growth, GSDP of Rs 31 lakh crore and per capita income of Rs 5.15 lakh by 2030.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: AP 2030 target -> 15% growth

new.s: Which Five Year Plan did the Janata Party government end a year early before adopting the Rolling Plan?
new.x: The Janata government ended the Fifth Plan (1974-79) a year early in 1978 and adopted the Rolling Plan.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: Janata ended Fifth Plan early

new.s: From which date did the Congress government's Sixth Five Year Plan begin after the Rolling Plan ended?
new.x: After the Janata government fell and the 1979-80 annual plan, the Congress Sixth Plan began on 1 April 1980.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: Congress Sixth Plan from 1 April 1980

new.s: What does NITI Aayog's State Support Mission help States to set up?
new.x: The State Support Mission helps States set up State Institutions for Transformation.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: State Support Mission -> State Institutions for Transformation

new.s: How many districts does the Visakhapatnam Economic Region of Andhra Pradesh cover?
new.x: The Visakhapatnam and Tirupati Economic Regions have 10 districts each; Amaravati has 9.
new.angle: U0452 notes gap: Visakhapatnam Economic Region -> 10 districts

new.s: What did the Perambur unit, set up under the Second Five Year Plan, manufacture?
new.x: Under the Second Plan, Perambur made railway coaches and Chittaranjan made locomotives.
new.angle: U0453 notes gap: Perambur -> coaches

new.s: Which Five Year Plan followed the Gadgil strategy of growth with stability?
new.x: The Fourth Plan (1969-74) was based on the Manne-Rudra model and the Gadgil strategy of growth with stability.
new.angle: U0453 notes gap: Gadgil strategy -> Fourth Plan

new.s: In which year was P.C. Mahalanobis awarded the Padma Vibhushan?
new.x: Mahalanobis received the Padma Vibhushan in 1968; he became FRS in 1945.
new.angle: U0453 notes gap: Mahalanobis Padma Vibhushan 1968

new.s: The Indian Statistical Institute Bill, 2026, introduced in the Lok Sabha in August 2026, seeks to replace which Act?
o: Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969
new.x: The ISI Bill, 2026 was introduced on 2 August 2026 to replace the ISI Act, 1959.
new.angle: U0453 notes gap: ISI Bill 2026 replaces ISI Act 1959

new.s: To which parliamentary committee was the Indian Statistical Institute Bill, 2026 referred?
o: Select Committee of the Rajya Sabha
new.x: On 1 September 2026 the ISI Bill, 2026 was referred to the Standing Committee on Finance.
new.angle: U0453 notes gap: ISI Bill 2026 -> Standing Committee on Finance

new.s: Which slogan of the 1990s is said to echo M.N. Roy's People's Plan?
new.x: The People's Plan's stress on basic needs was echoed in the 1990s slogan 'reforms with a human face'.
new.angle: U0453 notes gap: People's Plan -> reforms with a human face

new.s: Which Five Year Plan had the objective of 'growth with stability and progressive achievement of self-reliance'?
new.x: The Fourth Plan (1969-74) aimed at growth with stability and progressive achievement of self-reliance.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: growth with stability -> Fourth Plan

new.s: Who prepared the final draft of the Fifth Five Year Plan?
new.x: The Fifth Plan (1974-79) was based on the Dhar model; its final draft was prepared by D.P. Dhar.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Fifth Plan final draft -> D.P. Dhar

new.s: Which Five Year Plan had 'poverty eradication and technological self-reliance' as its main objective?
new.x: The Sixth Plan (1980-85) aimed at poverty eradication and technological self-reliance.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Sixth Plan objective

new.s: Under which government was the Ninth Five Year Plan, 'Growth with Social Justice and Equity', formulated?
new.x: The Ninth Plan (1997-2002) was formulated under the United Front Government; the NDC gave final approval on 19 February 1999.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Ninth Plan -> United Front Government

new.s: During which Five Year Plan was NABARD set up in 1982?
new.x: IRDP, NREP and NABARD (1982) belong to the Sixth Plan (1980-85).
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: NABARD -> Sixth Plan

new.s: In which Five Year Plan was the National Horticulture Mission launched in May 2005?
new.x: The National Horticulture Mission (May 2005) and NRHM (2005) came in the Tenth Plan, not the Eleventh.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: National Horticulture Mission -> Tenth Plan

new.s: What GDP growth target for the Twelfth Five Year Plan was finally approved by the National Development Council in December 2012?
new.x: The Approach Paper proposed 9%, but the NDC in December 2012 approved a target of 8%.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Twelfth Plan target 8% (NDC Dec 2012)

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Twelfth Five Year Plan:
1. Its Approach Paper proposed a GDP growth target of 9 per cent.
2. The National Development Council approved a lower target of 8 per cent.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Twelfth Plan target was 9% in the Approach Paper and was cut to 8% by the NDC in December 2012.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Twelfth Plan target 8% (NDC Dec 2012)

new.s: What average annual growth did the Tenth Five Year Plan achieve against its target of 8 per cent?
new.x: The Tenth Plan (2002-07) achieved 7.6% against a target of 8% (cut to 7% at mid-term).
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Tenth Plan achieved 7.6%

new.s: What growth rate did the Ninth Five Year Plan achieve against its target of 6.5 per cent?
new.x: The Ninth Plan (1997-2002) grew 5.4% against its 6.5% target.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Ninth Plan achieved 5.4%

new.s: Against a planned public sector outlay of Rs 4,800 crore, what was the actual outlay of the Second Five Year Plan?
new.x: The Second Plan's actual public outlay was Rs 4,600 crore (Rs 3,650 crore investment and Rs 950 crore current spending).
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Second Plan actual outlay Rs 4,600 crore

new.s: What was the size of the Twelfth Five Year Plan?
new.x: The Twelfth Plan outlay was Rs 76,69,807 crore, against Rs 36,44,718 crore for the Eleventh.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Twelfth Plan size

new.s: What Infant Mortality Rate target did the Twelfth Five Year Plan set?
new.x: The Twelfth Plan targeted an IMR of 25; the Eleventh had targeted 28.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Twelfth Plan IMR target 25

new.s: How many new jobs did the Eleventh Five Year Plan aim to create?
new.x: The Eleventh Plan aimed at 7 crore new jobs and a 10-point cut in the poverty head-count ratio.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Eleventh Plan 7 crore jobs

new.s: Construction of the Srisailam power project in Andhra Pradesh began in 1960. In which year was it opened?
new.x: Srisailam construction began in 1960 and the project was opened in 1981.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Srisailam opened 1981

new.s: Under the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula, the population of which Census was used?
new.x: The Gadgil-Mukherjee formula (1991) gave 60% weight to population as per the 1971 Census.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Gadgil-Mukherjee -> 1971 population

new.s: Under the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula, what weight was given to fiscal performance?
new.x: Weights: population 60%, per capita income 25%, fiscal performance 7.5%, special problems 7.5%.
new.angle: U0454 notes gap: Gadgil-Mukherjee fiscal performance 7.5%

new.s: After whom is the Prakasam Barrage on the Krishna river at Vijayawada named?
new.x: The barrage is named after Tanguturi Prakasam, the first Chief Minister of Andhra State.
new.angle: U0454 #8 AP projects -> Prakasam Barrage (web)

new.s: During which period was the present Prakasam Barrage across the Krishna at Vijayawada built?
new.x: The present barrage was built in 1954-57, replacing the old anicut of 1852-55.
new.angle: U0454 #8 AP projects -> Prakasam Barrage period (web)

new.s: In which year was the Planning Commission dissolved?
new.x: The Planning Commission was dissolved in 2014 and NITI Aayog replaced it on 1 January 2015.
new.angle: U0455 notes gap: Planning Commission dissolved 2014

new.s: The Fourth Five Year Plan grew only 3.3 per cent against a target of 5.7 per cent. What was the main reason?
new.x: The Fourth Plan fell short because of droughts and the 1971 war.
new.angle: U0455 notes gap: Fourth Plan shortfall -> droughts, 1971 war

new.s: Who succeeded Rajiv Kumar as Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog in May 2022?
new.x: Suman K. Bery was Vice-Chairperson from May 2022 to April 2026, after Rajiv Kumar (2017-22).
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: Vice-Chairperson 2022-26 -> Suman K. Bery

new.s: Before becoming Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog in April 2026, Ashok Kumar Lahiri had served as which of the following?
new.x: Ashok Kumar Lahiri, an economist and West Bengal MLA, is a former Chief Economic Adviser.
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: Ashok Kumar Lahiri -> former CEA

new.s: Which Director General of the DMEO served as interim CEO of NITI Aayog?
new.x: Nidhi Chhibber, DG of DMEO, was interim CEO between regular CEOs.
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: interim CEO -> Nidhi Chhibber

new.s: How many full-time members did NITI Aayog have when it was set up in 2015?
new.x: The 2015 set-up had 3 full-time members; the number is not fixed and is 5 at present.
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: 2015 set-up -> 3 full-time members

new.s: Who among the following was reported in June 2026 as a new full-time member of NITI Aayog?
new.x: Joram Aniya and R. Balasubramaniam were reported as new full-time members in June 2026.
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: new full-time member 2026 -> Joram Aniya

new.s: Which term is used for the cooperative federalism that NITI Aayog follows?
new.x: NITI's guiding approach is cooperative, or 'marble-cake', federalism.
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: cooperative = marble-cake federalism

new.s: Which of the following programmes is run by NITI Aayog?
new.x: NITI Aayog runs the Aspirational Districts Programme and the SDG India Index.

new.s: What was the theme of the 10th meeting of the Governing Council of NITI Aayog held in 2025?
o: Inclusive Human Development for Viksit Bharat@2047
new.x: The 10th meeting (2025) had the theme 'Viksit Rajya for Viksit Bharat@2047'; the 11th (2026) was on inclusive human development.
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: 10th Governing Council theme

new.s: Which of the following was NOT one of the sub-groups of Chief Ministers formed by NITI Aayog in 2015?
new.x: The 2015 CM sub-groups were on centrally sponsored schemes, skill development and Swachh Bharat.
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: CM sub-groups 2015

new.s: Under NITI Aayog's State Support Mission, what is Assam's state transformation unit called?
new.x: Assam's unit is SITA and Maharashtra's is MITRA.
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: Assam -> SITA

new.s: What size of economy does the Visakhapatnam Economic Region plan, made with NITI Aayog, aim for by 2047?

new.angle: U0456 notes gap: Visakhapatnam region -> USD 750-800 bn

new.s: On which date was the Reserve Bank of India nationalised?
new.x: The RBI, set up in 1935, was nationalised on 1 January 1949.
new.angle: U0456 notes gap: RBI nationalised 1 January 1949
